_comment: The soundtrack is not in this repository and is not required to build. Put a
file at tools/intro_video/soundtrack.mp3 and assemble.sh uses it; leave it
out and the video is built silent.
Kept here so a published video's music has a provenance: a stock licence
covers using a track in a project, not redistributing the file, and this
This is what the prototypes were cut against; any track works.
title: Stylish Upbeat Commercial Advertising Funk
